title: Ashoka ke abhilekh
hook: Ashoka ke abhilekh: 14 mukhya shilalekh, 7 stambh lekh; shuruaat 'Devanampiya Piyadasi'.
exam_points: 14 mukhya shilalekh, 7 stambh lekh; shuruaat 'Devanampiya Piyadasi'.
Maski aur Gujarra lekhon mein 'Ashoka' naam milta hai.
Kandahar aur Laghman se Greek/Aramaic lekh.

mcqs.q: Ashoka ke zyadatar abhilekh kis lipi mein hain?
